# Code of Conduct

## Our commitment

We want this project to be a welcoming and respectful space for everyone, regardless of background, identity, experience level, or point of view.

## Expected behavior

- Be respectful and considerate.
- Give and accept constructive feedback.
- Focus on what is best for the project and its community.
- Assume good intent, and address disagreements calmly.

## Unacceptable behavior

- Harassment, insults, or discriminatory language.
- Personal attacks, intimidation, or unwanted attention.
- Publishing another person's private information without permission.
- Any other conduct that would reasonably make the community unsafe or unwelcoming.

## Enforcement

Project maintainers may remove, edit, or reject contributions that violate this Code of Conduct. Repeated or serious violations may result in temporary or permanent exclusion from project spaces.

Report conduct issues privately to the project maintainer through [GitHub](https://github.com/MaxAndreev27). Please include enough information to help investigate. Reports will be handled as confidentially as possible.
